content_full:
Heya everyone!

We're making it easier to explore different styles in draft mode for V8.1. Include --sref random in your draft-mode prompt to create 24 images with different styles

To turn on draft mode, click the ⚡ icon in the prompt bar or include --draft in your prompt

Have fun!
